title: 设备售后服务与巡检协同系统
summary: B06 (focused round). Verified: multi-file upload of all 5 provided valid fixtures succeeded with saved business association on order SO-2026-0014; the association persisted across page reload; PNG preview rendered real image content and PDF preview rendered real text content (not just filenames); all 5 downloaded files were sha256-identical to the provided samples; corrupt.png and unsupported.exe each produced explicit failure feedback and were not added. One required part of B06 - in-app content display of the valid DOCX/XLSX/PPTX files - is BLOCKED by the test browser environment: those previews show 'Unable to render this Office Open XML file.' The app's Office renderer is a module blob Worker; the agent-browser allowed-domain Worker wrapper gives it a bootstrap with a top-level 'await import()' before the app code runs, so the init/parse messages posted at worker startup are dispatched during that await and dropped before self.onmessage is set. Re-posting the identical messages to the same live worker returned documentSessionOpened, and plain unguarded Chrome delivered the same immediate module-worker message; the queued-message behaviour is standard, so this is a browser-harness module-blob-Worker limitation (moduleBlobWorker handling), not a business defect, and no application repair is requested.
